description: Context passed to a chart tooltip, used both by TmChart's default tooltip and by any custom TooltipTemplate. Describes the hovered data point: its dataset, position, label, value, dataset label, and color.

members.name: DatasetIndex
members.description: Zero-based index of the dataset the hovered point belongs to.

members.name: Index
members.description: Zero-based index of the point within its dataset (the category/label index).

members.name: Label
members.description: Category label of the hovered point (the X-axis or slice label).

members.name: Value
members.description: Numeric value of the hovered point.

members.name: DatasetLabel
members.description: Label of the dataset (as shown in the legend).

members.name: Color
members.description: Resolved color of the hovered point or series.
